source.name: Sportcal, 'Benfica and Emirates extend shirt sponsorship deal to 2029' (five more seasons from 2024; Emirates official airline partner since 2014, shirt sponsor since 2015)

note: Benfica calls it the 'longest and most lucrative' front-of-shirt deal in its history; no value disclosed. Original 2015 announcement: Emirates media centre, 19 May 2015 (three-year front-of-shirt deal, 'Fly Emirates on the front of the SL Benfica jersey').
